lines.en: It moves forward with its head low.
Short legs shift a broad body along.
Its beak sweeps close to the ground.
Its tail drags an arc in the dirt.
It rounds a fern without breaking it.
It trots in short, steady steps.
It clambers over a fallen log.
Its belly scrapes along the ground.

lines.zh: 它在林间空地边上绕行
lines.en: It circles the edge of a clearing.

lines.zh: 它一边走一边嚼着东西
lines.en: It chews as it walks.

lines.zh: 它的爪子扒开落叶找食
lines.en: Its claws rake the leaf litter.
It halts, then carries on.
It follows its own old trail.

lines.zh: 它的影子低低地贴着地
lines.en: Its shadow stays low on the ground.
It lies still in the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我的喙，是专门咬硬叶的。
lines.en: My beak is made for tough leaves.
A hind leg scratches behind its ear.

lines.zh: 它把身体摊在温暖的土上
lines.en: It spreads out on warm soil.
It lifts its eyes to look around.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴轻轻搭在地上
lines.en: Its tail rests lightly on the ground.
It opens its mouth, showing flat teeth.
It nuzzles into the loose soil.

lines.zh: 一小片叶子落在它背上
lines.en: A small leaf lands on its back.
It blinks, then shuts its eyes.
Its breathing is slow.
It gives a short snort.

lines.zh: 它把脖子伸长晒着太阳
lines.en: It stretches its neck into the sun.
It draws back in and settles.
It raises its head at you.
Half a leaf still hangs from its mouth.
It blinks, uncomprehending.
It edges forward a little.
It tilts its head; no hostility.
Its nostrils flare.

lines.zh: 它把身体转向你的方向
lines.en: It turns its body your way.
Its mouth opens, then no sound.

lines.zh: 它低头继续吃，偶尔抬眼
lines.en: It goes back to eating, glancing up.

lines.zh: 它对你手里的叶子有兴趣
lines.en: The leaves in your hand interest it.
It puts its snout by your foot.
It backs half a step, timid.
It shrinks and burrows into the leaves.
It gives a low cry.
Its legs scrabble under it.
A mark appears on its back plate.
It turns itself with effort.
It pulls its head in toward itself.
It retreats downslope.
It stumbles and props itself up.

lines.zh: 我缩进落叶堆，小爪子抱紧头。
lines.en: I shrink into the leaf litter, little claws over my head.

lines.zh: 它还是想回去吃那片叶
lines.en: It still wants to go back to that leaf.

lines.zh: 它朝你手里的蕨叶来了
lines.en: It comes for the fern in your hand.
It reaches out and bites down.
Its mouth is green with chewing.
It presses forward while eating.
Done, it looks up for more.
It drags the leaves to its feet.
It eats slowly but never stops.
A claw pins the stem.
Its tail swings with contentment.
It sniffs close to your hand.
The bump tips it sideways.

lines.zh: 它靠着宽大的身体稳住了
lines.en: Its broad body holds it steady.
It slowly rights itself.

lines.zh: 它的背甲碰在你的鞋上
lines.en: Its back plate knocks your shoe.
It shifts off from your foot.
It gets shoved into the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 它抬起头看你有没有恶意
lines.en: It looks up to see if you mean harm.
It moves two steps and stops.
It lowers its head and eats again.

lines.zh: 它好像不太在意这一撞
lines.en: It hardly seems to mind.

lines.zh: 两只并排趴着，谁都不动
lines.en: Two lie abreast, neither moving.
They rest their heads together.

lines.zh: 一只替另一只蹭了蹭背
lines.en: One rubs along the other's back.
They chew in slow time.
Their breathing falls into step.

lines.zh: 它们挤在同一个土坑里
lines.en: They crowd into the same hollow.
Their tails lie crossing like old rope.

lines.zh: 它们就在那儿待了一下午
lines.en: They stay there all afternoon.
Leaves settle on both their backs.

lines.zh: 这片空地安静得能听见嚼声
lines.en: The clearing is quiet enough to hear them chew.
It takes the leaf in one bite.
It pins the food to the soil and tears.

lines.zh: 它拱开落叶找下面的东西
lines.en: It noses the litter aside.
It chews very carefully.
What it cannot chew, it spits out.
It drags the leaves into shade.
Front claws rake the food closer.
After eating it licks its lips.

lines.zh: 它把剩下的叶子踩在身下
lines.en: It keeps the rest under itself.
It turns to find the next patch.
It raises its head all at once.
It tightens up and backs away.
It gives a low, soft call.
It has decided you are a danger.
It tries to press into the litter.
Its legs scramble under it.
Eating is forgotten.

lines.zh: 它把头往壳一样的背下缩
lines.en: It pulls its head toward its shell-like back.
It heads for thicker brush.
It runs, clumsily.
It crashes through a fern.
It looks back once.
Its nostrils puff out a little dust.
It presses its head even lower.
It hides under a fern.
It keeps itself as low as it can.
Its breathing is quick and shallow.
It tries to work down the slope.
A stone blocks its path.
It struggles around it.
It stops and holds completely still.
It blends into the leaf litter.
It moves only when you move off.
Its eye never leaves you.

lines.zh: 它慢慢挪进更深的林子
lines.en: It creeps deeper into the trees.
The leaves hide it.
It tries several times and gets nowhere.
Its claws sink into the loose soil.
It starts squeezing into a rock gap.

lines.zh: 它猛地一咬，咬在你鞋上
lines.en: It bites down on your shoe.
It butts its head into your shin.

lines.zh: 它的爪子扒拉你的裤脚
lines.en: Its claws scrabble at your trouser leg.
It shakes its head to drag you.
It bites air; its teeth clack.
It turns and shoves with its back plate.
Slow movement, solid force.
It backs off and calls softly.

lines.zh: 它撞过来时自己也在晃
lines.en: It sways even as it charges.
It scatters leaves and raises dust.
It comes again, more urgent.
It bites and retreats into the ferns.
It rams you with its whole body.
Its beak clamps your finger.
A mound rises in the leaf litter.
It pushes out from under the leaves.
Bits of leaf cling to its back.
It lifts its head and looks about.
It shuffles forward a few steps.
It lowers its head and starts eating.

lines.zh: 它把一片蕨叶压倒在地
lines.en: It flattens a fern under itself.

lines.zh: 它的影子很宽，像块石头
lines.en: Its shadow is broad as a stone.

lines.zh: 它打了个响鼻，喷出尘土
lines.en: It snorts out a puff of dust.
It works along the edge of the clearing.
It stops and chews twice.
Then it sees you.
It does not run at once.
First it squares itself up.
Leaf sap still stains its beak.

lines.zh: 它慢慢朝你这个方向来
lines.en: It comes slowly in your direction.

lines.zh: 它的脚步把落叶压得响
lines.en: Its steps crackle through the leaves.
It arrives close to you.

lines.zh: 背甲被烤得发烫，它乱撞
lines.en: Its back plate heats and it blunders about.
It lands on its back, legs in the air.
Water fills its nostrils; it strains upward.

lines.zh: 冲击把它掀得滚了几圈
lines.en: The blast rolls it over and over.
An arrow sticks in the rim of its back plate.
Odd force sets its limbs jerking.
Starving, it barely moves.
Lightning freezes it on the ground.

lines.zh: 虚空拖它，短腿抓不住地
lines.en: The void pulls; short legs find no grip.
